groups.name: c-variadic-formatting
groups.reason: C variadic formatting is not type-safe; Rust string and non-variadic alternatives are exposed instead.

groups.name: legacy-columns
groups.reason: The obsolete Columns API is intentionally excluded in favor of tables.

groups.name: low-level-global-hooks
groups.reason: These APIs expose process-global allocators, ABI checks, or context-owned raw draw-list internals.

groups.name: internal-allocation
groups.reason: Raw ImGui allocation is used internally where ownership is immediately recovered; it is not a safe public allocator contract.

groups.name: font-baked-lifetime
groups.reason: A safe ImFontBaked wrapper must tie atlas mutation, density, and context-owned lifetimes together.
